input: When is a late fee added to a residential bill?
context: Billing Procedure BL-05: Residential bills are due 21 days after the bill date. A late fee of 1.5% of the unpaid balance is added if payment is not received by the due date. Late fees are waived once per 12 months on request.

input: How do I check if there is an outage in my area?
context: Outage Communication Standard OC-2: Customers can check outages on the outage map, which updates every 15 minutes. Estimated restoration times are shown once a crew has assessed the damage.

input: What must a technician do before working on a pole-mounted transformer?
context: Field Procedure FP-11: Before work on pole-mounted equipment, the technician must obtain a clearance from the control center, test for absence of voltage, and install protective grounds. Work may not start until all three steps are recorded.

input: What is the monthly price for the 500 Mbps internet plan?
context: Rate Card RC-2026: The 500 Mbps plan is $55 per month with autopay. Without autopay the price is $60 per month. Equipment rental is $10 per month unless the customer uses their own modem.

input: What should a care agent check before discussing a customer's account?
context: Customer Care Procedure CC-1: Before discussing any account details, the agent must verify the caller with the account PIN or a one-time code sent to the phone number on file. Unverified callers may receive only general information.

input: How fast must single-customer service outage tickets be resolved, and what if the technician needs parts?
context: Field Service Standard FS-4: Single-customer service outage tickets must be resolved within 24 hours. If parts are needed, the technician sets the ticket to pending parts and the customer receives an update by text.
